text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I am Symboli Rudolf.
Let us work together in harmonious unity. I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"...What I aim for is a world where all Umamusume can live in happiness.
To that end, what I must attain are achievements befitting an 'Emperor' who guides everyone."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Bearing the crown of supremacy upon myself, let us walk together toward the far-reaching end of this imperial road.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
